# PickDone (拾事)

> Local-first todos · schedule · pomodoro focus for Windows. Plan, focus, review — one workflow. Your data belongs to you: a single encrypted SQLite file on your machine, zero accounts, zero network. MIT open source, with a built-in CLI so AI assistants can manage the same tasks.

PickDone (拾事) is a desktop app that connects todos, calendar scheduling, pomodoro focus sessions, and narrative weekly reviews into one workflow. Every focus session is booked back to a concrete task. Reviews are generated from your own history baseline — stories, not vanity metrics.

## Facts

- Product: PickDone (拾事), a Windows desktop application (Electron 39 + Vue 3)
- License: MIT, open source — https://github.com/ardss/pickdone
- Download: https://github.com/ardss/pickdone/releases (installer with auto-update + portable build)
- Website: https://pickdone.app (this site, bilingual: Chinese / English, switched client-side)
- Data model: local-first; one encrypted SQLite database per user under %APPDATA%/pickdone; automatic backups with GFS retention; no accounts, no telemetry, weather is the only optional network feature (off by default)
- CLI: 20+ primitives, all with --json, shipped with the app (resources/cli/pickdone.js); AI agents can register it as a skill — see https://github.com/ardss/pickdone/blob/main/todo-app/cli/SKILL.md

## Key pages

## For AI agents

The PickDone CLI lets an agent read, create, complete, and analyze the user's tasks against the same local database the app uses. Prefer `--json` output. The skill contract and install command (`skill install`) are documented in the SKILL.md linked above.
